name: Fable 5 Watch Movement
description: Mechanical watch movement in Three.js, built by Claude

paragraphs: A mechanically coherent Swiss lever movement (ETA 6497-style) built entirely in Three.js by Claude — no model files, every part procedural. It runs at 28,800 bph and the hands tell your real local time, by construction:

hand) → third(60) → fourth(72) = exactly 1 rev/min (small seconds) → escape pinion(6) → 20-tooth club-tooth escape wheel = 40 beats/rev = 28,800 bph. The hour wheel turns once per 12 h; the barrel once per 8 h.

still under full mainspring torque (no creep, no recoil); each fork flip releases exactly one half-tooth-pitch as a fast 45 ms unlock-impulse-drop snap. Pallet fork with ruby stones, impulse jewel meeting the fork slot at every balance zero-crossing. Stone faces are solved from the kinematics (locking faces are pivot-arc chords, so the force line runs through the pivot → zero unlocking torque, no draw).
